title: Differentiation of Human iPSCs into Forebrain Neurons
author: Xylena Reed
materials: Aspirate E8 medium from iPSCs at 95–100% confluency.

steps.title: Plate iPSCs on Matrigel
steps.instruction: Coat plates with Matrigel, add E8 medium, and plate each iPSC line into one well of a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Grow iPSCs to confluency
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated iPSCs in E8 medium until cultures reach 95–100 % confluency.

steps.title: Start differentiation (Day 1)
steps.instruction: Aspirate the E8 medium, then add 5 mL per well of N3 medium supplemented with dorsomorphin (1.5 µM) and SB431542 (10 µM); incubate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Feed Days 1‑11 with dual‑SMAD inhibitors
steps.instruction: Each day from Day 1 to Day 11 replace the medium with fresh N3 medium containing dorsomorphin (1.5 µM) and SB431542 (10 µM), using 5 mL per well and incubating for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare dual‑SMAD inhibitor stocks
steps.instruction: For 500 mL of N3 medium add dorsomorphin stock (45 µL for 300 mL N3) and SB431542 stock (300 µL for 300 mL N3) to achieve the final concentrations of 1.5 µM and 10 µM respectively.

steps.title: Feed Days 12‑15 with N3 only
steps.instruction: From Day 12 to Day 15 replace the medium daily with N3 medium only (no dorsomorphin, no SB431542), using 5 mL per well and incubating for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Feed Days 16‑19 with RA
steps.instruction: From Day 16 through Day 19 replace the medium daily with N3 medium supplemented with retinoic acid (0.05 µM); use 5 mL per well, incubate for 10 minutes, protect the media from light. RA stock is 10 mM (e.g., add 1 µL stock to 200 mL N3).

steps.title: Coat plates with Poly‑L‑ornithine
steps.instruction: On Day 17, for each original 6‑well plate split the culture 1:2 onto two new 6‑well plates; add 1 mL Poly‑L‑ornithine per well and incubate overnight at 37 °C ensuring full well coverage.

steps.title: Coat plates with Fibronectin/Laminin
steps.instruction: On Day 18 remove the Poly‑L‑ornithine, wash wells 3× with DPBS, add 1 mL of Fibronectin/Laminin coating solution (prepared in DPBS, total 10 mL) per well, incubate 4 hours to overnight at 37 °C, wash wells 3× with DPBS, and keep DPBS in the final wash until cells are plated (do not let wells dry).

steps.title: Split cells 1:2 (Day 19)
steps.instruction: Aspirate media and rinse cells with 2 mL DPBS per well, add 1 mL Accutase per well and incubate 9 minutes at room temperature (monitor under a microscope and extend if needed). Add 1 mL DPBS, gently pipette to detach cells, transfer to a 15 mL tube, rinse the well with an additional 1 mL DPBS and combine the rinse in the tube. Centrifuge at 150 × g for 4 minutes, aspirate supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 2 mL N3 + RA + ROCK inhibitor, and plate cells 1:2 by adding 1 mL cell suspension into each prepared well containing 4 mL N3 + RA + ROCK inhibitor. Avoid harsh trituration; ROCK inhibitor improves survival after replating.

steps.title: Feed Days 20‑28 with N4
steps.instruction: Starting Day 20, replace the medium daily with N4 medium (N3 plus BDNF 2 ng/mL, GDNF 2 ng/mL, and RA 0.05 µM), using 5 mL per well and incubating for 10 minutes; continue until Day 28 or longer as desired.

steps.title: Freeze or transfer neurons (Day 24+)
steps.instruction: From Day 24 onward, neurons may be frozen or replated for assays. To freeze, harvest one well of a 6‑well plate into a single cryovial; to thaw, plate the contents of one vial into two wells. Maintain cultures with feeding every other day after thawing.
